questions_to_ask: What is the maximum capacity (standing and seated)?
Is catering in-house or can we bring our own?
What is the parking situation?
Is the venue fully accessible (wheelchair, hearing loop)?
What are the noise restrictions and curfew?
What is the deposit and cancellation policy?
red_flags: Reluctant to show the venue at different times of day
Hidden fees for cleaning, overtime, or setup
contract_checklist: Venue hire start and end times (including setup and breakdown)
Deposit amount, due date, and refund terms
Public liability insurance from the venue
Named backup contact if the coordinator changes

questions_to_ask: Can you provide a tasting session?
How do you handle dietary requirements and allergies?
What is your staff-to-guest ratio for service?
Do you carry public liability and food handler certifications?
What is your contingency plan if a key staff member is ill?
What is included (equipment, linen, service staff)?
red_flags: Cannot provide allergen information in writing
Unclear about what 'per head' pricing includes
contract_checklist: Menu confirmed in writing with all dietary options listed
Payment terms and final invoice process

questions_to_ask: Can we see a full event gallery (not just highlights)?
How do you back up photos on the day?
What is the turnaround time for edited images?
Who owns the copyright, and can we print/share freely?
Do you have a second shooter or backup photographer?
What happens if you are ill on the day?
red_flags: Portfolio shows only posed shots — no candids
Retains full copyright with restrictions on personal use
contract_checklist: Event date, hours, and locations covered

questions_to_ask: Are the flowers in season for our date?
Can you provide a mood board aligned with our theme?
What time can you set up at the venue?
Do you provide rentals (vases, stands, linens) or only florals?
What happens if a specific flower is unavailable?
Do you handle the breakdown and collection after the event?
red_flags: Cannot show examples of similar-sized events
Unwilling to confirm substitutions in advance
Setup time conflicts with venue access
contract_checklist: Full itemised list of flowers and décor elements
Colour palette and style confirmed in writing

questions_to_ask: Can we hear a live set or see a recent performance video?
Do you bring your own PA system?
How do you handle music requests (and do-not-play lists)?
What are your overtime rates?
Do you carry public liability insurance?
What is your backup plan if equipment fails?
red_flags: Unwilling to learn specific songs or accommodate requests
contract_checklist: Equipment list (and whether it covers the venue size)

questions_to_ask: Are you legally authorised to perform marriages in this jurisdiction?
How do you approach cultural or religious ceremony elements?
Can we customise the ceremony script?
How many rehearsals are included?
What is your backup plan if you are ill?
red_flags: Rigid script with no room for personalisation
No experience with your cultural or religious background
contract_checklist: Number of rehearsals and pre-ceremony meetings

questions_to_ask: How many vehicles and what capacity?
What are the pickup and drop-off routes and times?
Is the driver licensed and insured for passenger transport?
Is the vehicle accessible (wheelchair ramp)?
What is the overtime/waiting charge?
Can we do a tasting?
Can you accommodate allergen-free tiers?
How is the cake delivered and set up?
How far in advance is the cake made?
What if the cake is damaged in transit?
contract_checklist: Cake design, flavours, and tiers confirmed in writing

questions_to_ask: Do you have a current DBS check (if working with children)?
What is the age range best suited to your act?
What space and equipment do you require?
How long is the performance/session?
What is your public liability insurance cover?
red_flags: No DBS check when working with children

questions_to_ask: What permits are required for this type and size of event?
What is the application deadline and processing time?
Are there restrictions on noise levels, hours, or activities?
Is a road or public space closure required?
What are the fees?
red_flags: No response within 2 weeks of submission
Permit granted verbally — always get written confirmation
Fees significantly higher than typical — verify with another authority
contract_checklist: All required permits listed and applied for
Noise and hours restrictions noted in event plan
Conditions of permit met (e.g. stewarding, barriers)

questions_to_ask: Are all staff SIA licensed (UK) or hold equivalent local certification?
What is the staff-to-guest ratio you recommend?
Are you experienced with crowd management for this type of event?
Do you have a radio/communications plan?
What is your procedure for ejecting someone safely?
red_flags: No experience with similar scale events
contract_checklist: Number of licensed security staff confirmed

questions_to_ask: What qualifications do your first aiders hold?
What equipment will you bring (defibrillator, stretcher)?
How many staff per 100 guests?
What is your process for calling emergency services?
Do you have event liability insurance?
red_flags: No defibrillator for events over 200 people
contract_checklist: Qualifications of all first aid staff confirmed

questions_to_ask: Is the PA system sized for the venue and expected crowd?
Do you include a sound engineer on the day?
Can you provide a hearing loop for accessibility?
What is your setup time?
What backup equipment do you carry?
red_flags: PA underpowered for the venue size
No sound check before guests arrive
